1.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as workers strike at Canada's WestJet
1.summary: The strike by flight attendants at Canada's second-largest air carrier hits travellers on one of the busiest summer holiday weekends.

2.title: Ohio Republican Denies Abuse Accusations, Deepening High-Stakes Family Feud
2.summary: Representative Max Miller denied in a livestream the allegations of domestic abuse made by his ex-wife amid worries in the Republican Party that a once-safe seat may be in danger.

3.title: What We Know About the Shooting at an In-N-Out Burger in Idaho
3.summary: Gunfire brought panic to a shopping center in Twin Falls in what the authorities described as a chaotic scene. At least three people were killed.

4.title: Uganda unveils statue of Israel PM's brother who died in Entebbe rescue mission
4.summary: Yonatan Netanyahu was the only Israeli soldier to die as he led a mission to free more than 100 hostages.

5.title: After Most Migrants Leave Ceuta, Exhausted Holdouts Find Shelter on Beach
5.summary: Most of the people who surged into Spain on Thursday have since returned to Morocco. A small minority are holed up on a seafront, tired, hungry and vowing to stay.

6.title: At least 13 killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal
6.summary: Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah.
